sloka: चित्य माल्य अनुलेपः च आयस आभरणो अभवत् ।तम् दृष्ट्वा मंत्रिणः सर्वे त्यज्य चण्डाल रूपिणम् ॥१-५८-११॥
transliteration: citya mālya anulepaḥ ca āyasa ābharaṇo abhavat ।tam dṛṣṭvā maṁtriṇaḥ sarve tyajya caṇḍāla rūpiṇam ॥1-58-11॥

translations.english: "O Son of the Raghus (Rama) a thought arose in his mind to enter heaven with his physical body by performing a sacrifice.
